items.briefing:
A recent survey highlights a concerning trend for Australian organisations: executives continue to trust AI-generated outputs even after audit processes revealed errors in those results. This is a timely reminder that AI tools should support decision-making, not replace human verification — especially for compliance, finance, or student records in a training organisation context.

Separately, AI-enabled cyberattacks are becoming more sophisticated globally, and scam activity continues to affect Australians. Staff should remain alert to unexpected emails, messages, or requests that seem unusual, even if they appear to come from a trusted source.

**Practical tip:** Always double-check any AI-generated report or summary before acting on it — a quick human review can catch errors that could have serious consequences.

featured.title: Spinnaker names Rex Young as Chief Information Officer
featured.summary: The hire underscores Spinnaker's push to scale global support and AI tools as demand rises for alternatives to vendor-led software services.
